Automations for Home Assistant. Pick an app, add it to `apps.yaml`, push.

## Apps

### Lights

| App | Module | Class | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Sunrise Fade](docs/apps/sunrise-fade.qmd) | `sunrise_fade` | `SunriseFade` | Turns a light on dim before dawn, brightens it to sunrise, turns it off |
| [Sunset Fade](docs/apps/sunset-fade.qmd) | `sunset_fade` | `SunsetFade` | Brightens a light as the sun sets, leaves it on |
| [Light Fade](docs/apps/light-fade.qmd) | `light_fade` | `LightFadeApp` | Fades a light with your own levels, start times and direction |
